title: Accounts
about: Link your Facebook and TikTok accounts. Your AI agents use them to answer messages and comments, and for your ad numbers.
help: One click opens Facebook (or TikTok) in a new tab. Log in, choose your Pages and accept: Pilotix does the rest and the account turns green. The keys stay on Pilotix’s server, never in a page.

here.title: Used in “{{name}}”
here.noPage: No Page: link a Facebook account.

scopeHereHint: Its Page and ad accounts work here at once.
scopeAllHint: Each boutique then picks its Page in one click. A Page answers for one boutique only.

meta.name: Facebook and Instagram
meta.what: Your Pages, their messages and comments, and your ad accounts.
meta.allow: Facebook asks you to choose your Pages, Instagram accounts and ad accounts, then to allow Pilotix to manage them. Allow everything, or the agents cannot answer.
meta.notReady: Soon: Pilotix is getting the Facebook link ready.

tiktok.name: TikTok
tiktok.what: Your TikTok ad accounts. Their numbers come to Ads soon.
tiktok.notReady: Soon: Pilotix is getting the TikTok link ready.

waitingHelp: Finish in the {{name}} tab that opened: log in, choose your Pages and accept.
waitingPreview: Preview: the login is simulated and takes two seconds.
blocked: Your browser blocked the new tab. Open it with the button.
closed: The tab was closed before the end. Start again whenever you want.
none: No account linked yet. Start with Facebook: that is where your customers write to you.
relinkHint: Reconnect this account: a new token, Pages up to date.
relinkNow: Facebook no longer accepts this account: link it again.
removeAsk: Remove this account? The boutiques that use it lose its Page and ad accounts.

kind.pageNone: No Page shared with Pilotix. Link the account again and tick your Pages.
kind.ad_accountNone: No ad account (or no right to read it).
kind.advertiserNone: No TikTok ad account shared with Pilotix.

noHook: Its messages do not arrive yet: click “Test”.
unused: Your agents no longer use it.
pageSaved: Done: your agents answer on this Page.
pageStopped: Your agents no longer answer on this Page.
adsOn: Publicité now counts these ad accounts.
adsOff: Publicité no longer counts these ad accounts.
pageHint: Your agents answer this Page’s messages and comments in “{{name}}”.
noIg: No Instagram account on this Page
adsHint: Publicité adds up the numbers of all these accounts.
adsOther: This store counts those of “{{account}}”: turning these on replaces them.
adsMixed: In {{list}}: Publicité counts these accounts as dollars.
adsDzd: Accounts in dinars (DZD) count in dinars in Publicité.

token.bad: Facebook refuses the key: click “Link again”.

tokenTiktok.bad: TikTok refuses the key: click “Link again”.

perms.warn: Missing permissions: {{list}}. Click “Link again” and accept everything.

page.bad: Page “{{name}}”: its key no longer works. Click “Link again”.

pageNone.warn: No Page chosen for this store: choose it above.

pageHook.ok: Page subscribed: its messages and comments reach Pilotix.
pageHook.fixed: Page subscribed again: its messages and comments reach Pilotix.
pageHook.bad: Pilotix cannot subscribe the Page to its messages.

igInbox.ok: @{{username}}’s Instagram inbox: Pilotix can read it.
igInbox.bad: @{{username}}’s Instagram inbox: Meta refuses. The reason is just below.

fbComment.ok: Last customer comment from Facebook that Pilotix got: {{when}}.
fbComment.warn: Pilotix hasn’t got any Facebook comment for “{{name}}” yet. Comment on one of the Page’s posts from another account, then test again.
fbComment.lost: Facebook sent a comment {{when}}, but no shop took it.

igComment.ok: Last customer comment from Instagram that Pilotix got: {{when}}.
igComment.warn: Pilotix hasn’t got any Instagram comment for @{{username}} yet. Comment on one of @{{username}}’s posts from another account, then test again.
igComment.lost: Instagram sent a comment {{when}}, but no shop took it.

catchUp.ok: Safety net: Pilotix read Messenger and Instagram again {{when}}. Messages caught: {{n}}.
catchUp.warn: Safety net: not run yet. It reads Messenger and Instagram again every 3 minutes.
catchUp.error: Safety net: Pilotix couldn’t read the messages {{when}}. The reason is just below.

igSeen.ok: Last customer message from Instagram that Pilotix got: {{when}}.
igSeen.warn: Pilotix hasn’t got anything from Instagram for @{{username}} yet. Send @{{username}} a message from another account, then test again.
igSeen.lost: Instagram sent a message {{when}}, but no shop took it. Send a new message, then test again.
igSeen.standby: Instagram sends its messages to another app first ({{when}}). In Facebook › Page setup › Instagram conversation routing, choose Pilotix.
igSeen.other: Pilotix gets Instagram ({{when}}), but no customer message yet. Send @{{username}} a message from another account, then test again.
igSeen.unknown: Pilotix got nothing for @{{username}}, but Meta sent an Instagram message {{when}} for an account no shop uses.

appHook.ok: Meta app: Facebook messages and comments reach Pilotix.
appHook.warn: Meta app, “Page” line of Webhooks: subscribe {{list}}.

appHookIg.ok: Meta app: Instagram messages and comments reach Pilotix.
appHookIg.warn: Meta app, “Instagram” line of Webhooks: subscribe {{list}}.

reach.ok: Webhook address: it answers from the Internet.
reach.cloudflare: Webhook address: Cloudflare blocks it. Let “/hooks/” through in Cloudflare.

adsCurrency.ok: Ad accounts in dinars (DZD): Advertising counts them in dinars, and in dollars with your monthly rate.
adsCurrency.warn: Ad accounts in {{list}}: Advertising counts them as dollars.

igLogin.ok: Instagram login: @{{username}}’s key works. Dellal uses it to answer all your Instagram customers.
igLogin.warn: Instagram login: not done yet for @{{username}}. Without it (or Meta’s approval), Dellal answers on Instagram only accounts that have a role on the app. Add it in Message AI agent › Settings.
igLogin.bad: Instagram login: the key no longer works. The reason is just below.

badSig.warn: Pilotix refused messages from Meta {{when}} ({{n}} times): their signature matches no secret. With Instagram’s own login, paste the Instagram app secret in the control room › Pilot AI › Settings & costs › Meta and TikTok accounts.
